name: playwright-logbook-vscode
description: See a Playwright failure's recorded history and open its recorded source location.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Read workspace-contained history and open workspace-contained source. External mappings require trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: This preview reads local desktop files only.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Logbook reads history collected by its reporter. For CI results, download the Logbook records and select their folder. This preview does not fetch CI records automatically.
[Select History Folder](command:logbook.selectStore)

logbook.historyPath.description: History folder relative to this workspace folder. External stores require workspace trust.

logbook.sourceRoot.description: Mapped checkout root. Recorded paths and historical lines may differ from the current checkout.

logbook.autoRefresh.description: Refresh after committed history changes without switching the selected execution.
